Senior Product Manager — Payments
Northwind Financial | London (hybrid)

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own our payments platform. You
will set the roadmap for how money moves through Northwind, working closely with
engineering, risk, compliance and our largest merchant partners.

What you will do
- Own the strategy and roadmap for the payments platform end to end.
- Make hard prioritisation calls across competing merchant, risk and internal
  demands, and communicate the reasoning clearly.
- Partner daily with a team of twelve engineers and two designers.
- Define and track the metrics that tell us whether payments are getting better,
  not just busier.
- Work with compliance on regulatory change without letting it stall delivery.
- Mentor two junior product managers.

What we are looking for
- 10+ years in product management, with meaningful time in fintech or payments.
- A track record of shipping complex platform products, not just features.
- Comfort with technical depth: you should be able to argue with an engineer
  about idempotency and hold your own.
- Experience influencing senior stakeholders who do not report to you.
- Excellent communication skills and a bias for action.

Nice to have
- Experience with card scheme rules or PSD2.
- Exposure to marketplace or multi-party payment flows.
